_note: UI-030. THE nav, in one place. Nothing reads this file yet — UI-031/UI-032 do,
when they migrate pages onto 04-objects/shell.css. It exists now so the nine pages
stop each inventing their own nav, which is how the app reached three different
versions of it (measured at UI-030: bank/blueprint/library/print carry 5 items,
index 10, slo/slo-health/taqseem 7, and landing has no nav at all).
Group names, order and item set are the design target's (static/mockup-modern.html
nav block). Labels, urls, icons and i18n keys are the LIVE app's, not the mockup's —
e.g. the mockup says 'Generate paper', the pages say 'Generator'. Every icon id was
verified present in static/icons.svg (all 11) and every url returns 200.
The mockup's nav is 11 items in 4 groups and this config carries all 11, same groups,
same order — two labels differ because the live app's differ ('Generator' not 'Generate
paper', 'More / settings' not 'School settings'). Three of the 11 ('My Papers',
'Adaptive paper', 'Analytics') looked like mockup fiction and are NOT: they are real SPA
screens inside index.html. Counted, not estimated — an earlier draft of this line said 12
and was caught in review. Nothing here is invented.
'url' vs 'screen' is the thing to understand before rendering this.
A 'url' item is a real page. A 'screen' item exists ONLY inside index.html, shown by
showScreen(...) with no address of its own — so from slo.html there is no way to link
to it today. Four items are 'screen'-only — mypapers, adaptive, analytics, settings —
which is one more than the three listed above as looking like fiction; 'More / settings'
obviously exists, it just has no address either.
Inventing a convention for it (/#mypapers, /?screen=...) is a UI-031/UI-032 decision
with JS attached; it is deliberately NOT decided here. See docs/ui/DEFERRED.md D25.
'Generator' carries both: it is screen 'generate' on index.html and url '/' elsewhere.
i18n is asymmetric and that is the live state, not an omission here: the four SPA
items carry data-i18n keys with English+Urdu strings, the six page links carry none.
'nav.mypapers' is referenced by index.html markup but has NO entry in its translation
table — a live gap, recorded as docs/ui/DEFERRED.md D24 rather than fixed, since this
task authors no markup or JS.
